deities: Goddess Mahakali (four-armed, Padmasana; holds sword, spear, damaru and amrut kalash; silver-shielded stone idol)
Goddess Manikyalamma (idol discovered during well repairs, installed beside Mahakali)
festivals: Bonalu / Ashada Jathara (Ashada, July-August; Secunderabad celebrations on the second Sunday of Ashada)

history.dynasty: British cantonment-era, early 19th century; founded by Suriti (Surati) Appaiah, a military doli (palanquin) Bearer <redacted> 1814-1815; administered today by the Telangana Endowments Department
history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: CSV row 2323 ('Sri Ujjaini Mahakali Temple', Secunderabad, Telangana) is a confirmed duplicate of seq 981 ('Sri Ujjaini Mahakali Temple', Secunderabad - id ujjaini-mahakali-temple-secunderabad). Name, town, state and the famous-Mahankali identity all match exactly: the Shakti temple at General Bazaar, Secunderabad, founded 1814-1815 by doli Bearer <redacted> Suriti Appaiah after the 1813 cholera epidemic, and the centre of Secunderabad's Bonalu jathara (second Sunday of Ashada). Deduplicate downstream; keep seq 981 as the primary record. Research carried over from the primary record (seq 981); sources below are those consulted for that record.

name: Sri Ujjaini Mahakali Temple
town_description: Secunderabad is the twin city of Hyderabad, originally a British cantonment, and falls within Hyderabad district of Telangana. The temple stands in the bustling General Bazaar area of Secunderabad and is the cultural focal point of the city's Ashada Bonalu festivities.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad, about 35-40 km south (verify)
travel.road: In the General Bazaar area of Secunderabad; well connected by city buses and autos; street parking nearby, which can be difficult during Bonalu (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: July-August (Ashada) for the Bonalu jathara - very crowded; quieter on regular mornings
visitor_information.opening_hours: Morning 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and evening 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM (verify; one source lists 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-9:00 PM). Best visiting days: Sundays and Tuesdays
